messages:
mike: Nightdash p99 up ~22% on canary starting 02:12 UTC after today's runtime-merge. spike visible across eu-west and us-central.
leila: saw it. correlates with commit 9f3c7a2 -> scheduler/stride-prefetch change
dan: digging into kernel_selector traces now. pulling recent perf profiles.
perf-bot: nightly-perf: canary p99 latency 265ms (+22%) vs baseline 218ms. affected model: gpt-j-6B, seq=1024
kiara: quick check: CI perf job for master also failed yesterday, flagged by ci-bot.
ci-bot: perf-ci: job perf/presubmit/large-models failed on master at 2025-11-08T01:45:12Z. p95 regression +18%.
mike: can someone paste kernel_selector logs from the canary nodes?
dan: paste:
```
[2025-11-09T02:10:05Z] kernel_selector: chosen_kernel=matmul_opt_v2 reason=latency_model_est
[...]
[2025-11-09T02:10:05Z] kernel_selector: fallback_kernel=matmul_opt_v1 estimated_delta_ms=+34
```
leila: so v2 is being chosen now; earlier baseline used v1 for many long sequences.
kiara: profiler flamegraph: shows matmul_opt_v2 has worse L2 hit pattern for our tiling on A100p 80GB.
dan: hypothesis: the merge changed the selection threshold epsilon from 0.05 -> 0.12 (more aggressive pick of v2).
mike: can we repro locally with the regression test harness? I'll run batch of seq=1024.
perf-bot: run queued: perf/harness/strided-repro #732
kiara: local run reproduces p99 bump once kernel_selector picks v2. attaching perf counters: L2_MISS +40%, p95 kernel_time +28%
dan: quick mitigation: we can force kernel_selector to prefer v1 via runtime flag `--kernel-prefer=matmul_opt_v1` on canary pools.
mike: canary change applied to eu-west-1 canaries. monitoring.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary flag update to kernel selector on eu-west canary pool by mike at 02:35Z
leila: also opened PR to revert epsilon change: PR#4387 (revert scheduler/stride-prefetch epsilon bump). ready for review.
ci-bot: perf-ci: rerun perf/presubmit/large-models on PR#4387 -> queued
kiara: if revert lands, we should still follow-up with a targeted microbenchmark of matmul_opt_v2 to see why L2 worsened.
dan: agreed. assigning follow-up to dan + kiara. created ticket PERF-876: microbench matmul kernels on A100p.
mike: can we keep rollout paused until CI green? I don't want to sweep this into stable.
leila: paused. marking rollout status: HOLD. tagging release lead @product-ops.
kiara: note for postmortem: batching heuristics + kernel selector interaction wasn't covered by existing regression tests (they only vary batch size, not stride/prefetch config).
mike: thanks all, monitor for 1h, if canary p99 returns close to baseline we can resume. otherwise we'll merge revert and issue hotfix.
perf-bot: update: canary eu-west p99 down to +6% at 03:10Z after flag. still above baseline.
leila: PR#4387 perf run shows p95 within baseline; p99 improved but not fully resolved.
dan: plan: merge revert if perf-ci passes. schedule hotfix window 04:30Z if needed.
kiara: leaving notes in the ticket about kernel autotune telemetry we should add (report selection rationale, histograms of epsilon decisions).
mike: thanks. closing loop for now; will post final after CI.
